description: Scale-model Hartzell-like case for CCBlade + AcousticAnalogies free-field (X-EXTRAP). Chord/twist are engineering estimates for 0.762 m dia 3-blade; not OEM data. pitch_offset_deg and thickness_over_chord tuned so ℓ=1 peak SPLs are within ~15 dB of ANOPP Table 8 (loading-only; compact thickness overpredicts at this tip clearance).
reference: Pain Validation.pdf Tables 7–9; 0.762 m dia 3-bladed Hartzell @ 3000–5000 rpm; User Manual methodology x1=0.457+a(1-cos…)

propeller_placement.note: r_p = a + 0.457 from User Manual / methodology x1 grid (tip clearance ~0.076 m for 0.381 m Rtip)
